steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. For live voltage checks, use proper PPE and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in service mode
steps.body: Service mode entered. Use Light key (SW2) to navigate to the step for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Use SW2 to advance steps; SW5 toggles loads.

steps.title: Navigate to service step 19
steps.body: Use Light key (SW2) to advance until Freezer TEMP LEDs show step 19 (Water valve). Wait at least 1 second between key presses.

steps.title: Activate water valve
steps.body: At step 19, press water paddle to activate valve. Valve stays on after paddle release — press Light key (SW2) to exit.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At step 19, press water paddle to activate valve. Valve stays on after paddle release — press Light key (SW2) to exit.

steps.title: Water valve flows
steps.body: Does water valve open and dispense when paddle pressed?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Does water valve open and dispense when paddle pressed?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: No flow — check P3-4 120 VAC output, valve, or filter.

steps.title: Replace water valve
steps.oemOutcome: Replace dispenser water valve or repair harness.

steps.title: Water valve verified
steps.oemOutcome: Water valve operates in service step 19.
